claim: All of Us data includes electronic health records, surveys, and physical measurements from consented participants.
quote: data from electronic health records (EHRs), surveys, and physical measurements

claim: All of Us generates genomic data via short-read WGS, long-read WGS, and genome-wide genotyping.
quote: short-read whole genome sequencing, long-read whole genome sequencing, and genome-wide genotyping to call single nucleotide polymorphism, insertion, and deletion variants (SNPs and Indels) and structural variants

claim: All of Us participants can contribute wearable device data such as Fitbit (heart rate, activity, sleep).
quote: such as Fitbit devices, which track biometric data, including heart rate, physical activity, and sleep

claim: The Controlled Tier dataset adds genomic data including short-read WGS, long-read WGS, structural variants, and genotyping arrays.
quote: genomic data in the form of short-read whole genome sequences (WGS), long-read WGS, structural variants, and genotyping arrays

quote: integrated cloud-based analysis tools, including Jupyter Notebook, RStudio, and SAS Studio

quote: Researchers with R, Python, or SAS experience can perform queries and analyses within the

claim: Each registered Researcher Workbench user receives $300 in initial cloud credits.
quote: provides $300 in initial credits for each registered Researcher Workbench user

claim: All of Us curation uses OMOP to standardize data.
quote: Our data curation process uses OMOP to standardize data to ensure high-quality data for research

claim: All of Us uses the OMOP Common Data Model to standardize all EHR data.
quote: We use the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) Common Data Model (CDM) to standardize all EHR data

claim: All of Us implements security controls at the FISMA Moderate baseline derived from NIST 800-53.
quote: We have implemented security controls at the FISMA Moderate baseline, leveraged from NIST 800-53, to build a robust security framework

claim: Data available to researchers has direct identifiers removed and is modified to minimize re-identification risk.
quote: had direct identifiers removed and has been further modified to minimize re-identification risks

claim: Authorized users receive a 'data passport' required to access registered and controlled tiers and create workspaces.
quote: The data passport is required for gaining access to the registered and controlled data tiers

claim: All of Us workspaces are collaborative and can be shared among registered researchers on a project team.
quote: Workspaces are collaborative and can be shared among other registered researchers within a project team

claim: The interactive Data Browser exposes aggregate data across EHR, genomic sequencing, surveys, physical measurements, and Fitbit.
quote: aggregate-level data derived from electronic health records, genomic sequencing, survey responses, physical measurements, and Fitbit activity

claim: N3C harmonizes clinical data into the OMOP Common Data Model (v5.3).
quote: N3C harmonizes clinical data into the OMOP Common Data Model

claim: N3C harmonizes EHR data to OMOP 5.3.
quote: N3C utilizes harmonized EHR data to OMOP 5.3. For a detailed list of available data elements, please see OMOP CDM v5.3

claim: N3C collects EHR-derived demographics, lab results, procedures, medications, conditions, and physical measurements.
quote: demographics, lab test results, procedures, medications, medical conditions, physical measurements and more

claim: Data stay within the N3C Enclave with no download or capture of raw data.
quote: Data stay within the N3C Enclave: No download or capture of raw data

claim: The N3C Palantir Foundry platform runs in AWS and is FedRAMP authorized at Moderate impact level.
quote: The Palantir Foundry platform in use resides in Amazon Web Services and is Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program authorized at a Moderate impact level

claim: Approved N3C users analyze data only within the platform; no EHR data may be downloaded.
quote: Approved users can analyze data only within the platform. No data from the EHRs may be downloaded

claim: All N3C data is encrypted both in transit and at rest, without exception.
quote: All data is encrypted both in transit and at rest, without exception

quote: Supports Python, R, SQL, PySpark, and SparkR

claim: N3C Code Workbooks allow exporting code to GitHub.
quote: Exporting code to GitHub

claim: N3C tooling facilitates a collaborative environment producing artifacts interoperable across Enclave applications.
quote: facilitate a collaborative environment in which you can quickly iterate over logic to produce artifacts interoperable with the suite of Enclave applications

claim: Foundry's Notepad in N3C supports secure team dissemination of results within the Enclave.
quote: Foundry's Notepad for reporting results for secure team dissemination within the Enclave environment

claim: N3C code branching facilitates collaboration and reproducibility.
quote: branching facilitates collaboration and reproducibility

claim: More than 90 institutions worked together to build N3C as a national real-world data resource.
quote: More than 90 institutions worked together to build N3C

claim: On the UKB-RAP, bulk data-fields are dispensed to projects as files.
quote: Bulk data-fields are dispensed as files.

quote: Tabular data-fields and linked health data are placed into a Spark SQL database and an associated dataset.

claim: The UK Biobank Research Analysis Platform is built on the DNAnexus Platform.
quote: The UK Biobank Research Analysis Platform is built on the DNAnexus Platform, and using the two is largely the same experience.

claim: Users can collaborate on the DNAnexus Platform by giving project access to other users.
quote: You can collaborate on the DNAnexus Platform by giving project access to other users.

claim: Users can build and deploy custom workflows for processing and analyzing data on the platform.
quote: Learn to build and deploy custom workflows for processing and analyzing data.

claim: The platform provides a JupyterLab Spark Cluster app with a fully managed Spark cluster.
quote: you can use a fully managed Spark cluster

quote: Users can set up a personal billing account to pay for any charges they incur when running analyses, storing data on the DNAnexus Platform, or egressing data from the Platform.

quote: The Monthly Project Spending Limit for Computing and Egress feature allows setting separate project-level monthly spending limits

quote: using `dx` command-line client

quote: can restrict the ability of project members to view, copy, delete, and download project data.
